inclusions.source: What you are buying, in essence, is a guided after-dark experience of a site most visitors have already seen by daylight, plus return transport to your Luxor hotel.

inclusions.text: Return transport to your Luxor hotel
inclusions.source: What you are buying, in essence, is a guided after-dark experience of a site most visitors have already seen by daylight, plus return transport to your Luxor hotel.

inclusions.text: Hotel transfer private to your party
inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party; the show itself is a shared, ticketed performance at the temple.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person for the transfer
inclusions.source: The outing takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided for the transfer.
The evening begins with a pick-up from your Luxor hotel.
